problem_title: How to display error message conditionally in omniscript based on remote action response
problem: I have a remote action that calls Apex class from OmniScript after 'Next' click. The logic in apex class is complex and might result in a situation where user can not move ahead in the omniscript flow and we need to show them an error message which is something as "You can not proceed ahead due to so-and-so reason". This is one of the scenarios, while at other times if the apex logic verifies that user can navigate...
explanation: The 2nd approach has worked. It did not refresh earlier probably, or required multiple refreshes.
